definition: a traveler riding in a vehicle, not driving it
description: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

taps.phrase: to look up at the screens
